notes_for_editor: The 1949 build year rests on the NHLR page alone; no second source for the build date was read. Location (Nickerson State Park, Deer Park Road) is confirmed by the Cape Cod Fire Department listing and the Mass.gov review. Conflict to flag: the Mass.gov review says the tower is atop Deer Park Hill, but also that Brewster and Wellfleet are not located on hills. Administrator: the register names Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control; the Cape Cod Fire Department listing calls it a DCR District 1 fire tower. The sources read do not say which office runs it today, so the story gives only the register's name. Record coordinates match NHLR (41.760220, -70.041520); the OSM node in the record (41.758097, -70.035366) is roughly 500 m away and was not cited. The record's 'restored 2015' event is better described as stair platforms replaced (a repair), so the event is recorded as modified. Staffing, access for climbing, and condition today are not in any source read; the NHLR page has no visit reports for Brewster. The Mass.gov review is undated (its citations include a 2011 work), so it is not evidence of current status. No photos added; the Mass.gov review refers to photos in an appendix that was not read. Checked 2026-10-08: the NHLR page as read is 936 characters with no staffing or visit-report section, which supports the story's absence statement; the register's own text says 'Built 1949' and 'Mass. Bureau of Forest Fire Control' for administration, while its description names the Massachusetts Bureau of Fire Control as builder. The story now says the state review is inconsistent about the landform, rather than that the sources disagree, because the register also places the tower on Deer Park Hill.
